## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台测试清单 batch E 的 29 行逐行实测后,改了 21 个条目的文字(`integration-system.json` 12 个、`automation.json` 9 个)和 `qa-flow-status-doors` 配方第 5 步的遥测库文件名;每个条目升一版 revision,加一条 history。
- 为什么改:产品是对的,清单文字落后,QA 照跑会误判失败或卡在搭环境(例如安装门拒收 handler 型 job、遥测库文件名写错、暂停节点被改掉后其实按原版本继续运行而不是 404)。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` 下两个 JSON,不发布、不进运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`automation.json` 的 `automation.trigger-status-contract` acceptance[5](404 只剩“流程被注销”一支)、`integration-system.json` 的 `integration-system.job-package-key` fixtures(body 型 job 与 `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED`)、`qa-flow-status-doors` 第 5 步(`trigger.db` → `trigger.telemetry.db`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期 `OK — 16 areas, 427 items`,symbol anchors 为 `1650/1660 resolved`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Two files, text only: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` (12 items) and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` (9 items, plus the area-level recipe `qa-flow-status-doors` step 5, which lives in that same file's `fixtures` block). Every edited item bumps `revision` once and appends one `history` row citing this card and its source record. The recipe has no revision field, so its step-5 correction is recorded in the history row of the item that drives that step, `automation.trigger-status-contract`.

Per-row dispositions, every row re-measured on `origin/main` before editing (base `87330e89`, merged up to `82838e83`, which touched no checklist file):

Totals: 29 rows · 23 re-pointed over 21 items (rows 139 and 140 share one item; row 194 is recipe text) · 2 already right (259, and 85's automation.json half) · 1 needs a live drive (84) · 4 routed to sibling batches (202, 213, 240, 241, plus 85's api-backend half) · 0 needs_decision.

No product code, no `scripts/qa/**`, no RUNNER.md, no other area file. `coverage.json` and `FOLLOW-UPS.md` were not touched: the gate neither regenerated nor required them.

## Why

Each row is a parked checklist-accuracy line from the v18.4.0 sweep (#32908 ledger, report 6881013689): the product is right and the item text either fails it, misleads a run, or names a fixture recipe that no longer works. The card's readings came from `87330e89` and were not driven live, so each was re-read from source here first; the source records are QA comments 6844741021, 6846028996, 6846283471, 6850173588, 6850793622, 6850899929 and 6851700388 on #32908, and record bodies #32940, #32949, #33025, #33048, #33058, #33081, #33092, #33093 and #33096.

## Tests

No test added or changed: the diff is checklist text only. Nothing is ablated (docs are not ablated). Semantic diff, parsed JSON against `origin/main`: only the 21 items' named fields, their `revision`, one new `history` row each, and the recipe's `sequence[4]` `call`/`expect`/`source` changed; item counts are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Row 84 needs a live drive: source does not show why a qa_b build failed (probe above). A runner who meets it should record the build's error text; the item stays as it is until then.
- Two record claims re-read narrower than the ledger line. Row 139: the item's "a body-only HMAC answers 401" was already true; the edit only spells the body-only form so a bare hex is not mistaken for it. Row 259: `--fresh` still exists, so nothing was owed.
- `notify-inbox-delivery` acceptance[4]'s push probe was not re-judged: row 51 asked only for where to count and who can read. Since the messaging plugin now registers a lazy push provider at `kernel:ready` (row 49's finding), whether that probe still meets the "not registered" WARN is a question for the next live run; QA record #32949 scored the item PASS with a push-only warning.
- The `qa-flow-status-doors` knownGaps[1] note ("read from code, not yet re-driven live") was proven live per record #32949, but it is not one of this card's rows, so it is left.
- `skip-changeset`: `docs/qa/**` ships in no package.
- Every edit was read from source at the base, not driven live; each history row says so.
